title: Chemical Peel
summary: Our chemical peels exfoliate the skin, removing dead cells and revealing a fresh layer. Ideal for treating acne, fine lines, and pigmentation issues.

sections.heading: Chemical Peels
paragraphs: Chemical peels use a chemical solution to exfoliate and peel the skin, revealing smoother, more even skin. They help with wrinkles, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, uneven skintone and texture.

sections.body:
Chemical peels use a chemical solution to exfoliate and peel the skin, revealing smoother, more even skin. They help with wrinkles, acne scars, hyperpigmentation, uneven skintone and texture.

Chemical peels are classified into three main categories based on the depth of skin penetration:

sections.heading: 1. Superficial Peels
paragraphs: Description: These peels penetrate only the outermost layer of the skin (epidermis) and provide a gentle exfoliation. They are typically used to improve mild skin discoloration, fine lines, and rough texture.
Recovery Time: Little to no downtime, with mild redness and scaling that resolves within 1-7 days.
Best For: Mild acne, fine lines, dull complexion, and minor pigmentation issues.
sections.body:
-  **Description** : These peels penetrate only the outermost layer of the skin (epidermis) and provide a gentle exfoliation. They are typically used to improve mild skin discoloration, fine lines, and rough texture.
-  **Recovery Time** : Little to no downtime, with mild redness and scaling that resolves within 1-7 days.
-  **Best For** : Mild acne, fine lines, dull complexion, and minor pigmentation issues.

sections.heading: 2. Medium Peels
paragraphs: Description: Medium-depth peels penetrate the outer and middle layers of the skin, making them more effective for treating moderate skin issues such as wrinkles, acne scars, and pigmentation.
Recovery Time: Typically 7-14 days, with peeling, redness, and swelling during recovery. Sun protection and careful skincare are crucial during the healing process.
Best For: Moderate wrinkles, acne scars, uneven pigmentation, and sun damage.
sections.body:
-  **Description** : Medium-depth peels penetrate the outer and middle layers of the skin, making them more effective for treating moderate skin issues such as wrinkles, acne scars, and pigmentation.
-  **Recovery Time** : Typically 7-14 days, with peeling, redness, and swelling during recovery. Sun protection and careful skincare are crucial during the healing process.
-  **Best For** : Moderate wrinkles, acne scars, uneven pigmentation, and sun damage.

sections.heading: 3. Deep Peels
paragraphs: Description: Deep peels penetrate deeper into the skin's middle layers and are used for more severe skin issues, such as deep wrinkles, significant sun damage, and scars.
Recovery Time: Requires a longer recovery time, ranging from 2-4 weeks, and involves significant peeling, swelling, and redness. The skin may take several months to fully recover.

Best For: Deep wrinkles, scars, and extensive sun damage. These peels are typically performed once and are suitable for lighter skin tones due to the risk of hypopigmentation (lightening of the skin).

-  **Description** : Deep peels penetrate deeper into the skin's middle layers and are used for more severe skin issues, such as deep wrinkles, significant sun damage, and scars.
-  **Recovery Time** : Requires a longer recovery time, ranging from 2-4 weeks, and involves significant peeling, swelling, and redness. The skin may take several months to fully recover.
-  **Best For** : Deep wrinkles, scars, and extensive sun damage. These peels are typically performed once and are suitable for lighter skin tones due to the risk of hypopigmentation (lightening of the skin).

sections.heading: 4. Combination Peels
paragraphs: Combination Peels address multiple skin concerns like acne, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and uneven texture
Acne Peels: Blend salicylic acid and lactic/gylcolic acids to cleanse pores and reduce inflammation
Anti-Aging Peels: Use glycolic acid, TCA, and retinoic acid to reduce fine lines and boost collagen.
Pigmentation Peels: Combine kojic acid, madelic acid, and TCA to lighten dark spots and even skin tone.
Brightening Peels: Include Vitamic C, glycolic acid, and retinol to fade pigmentation and enhance radiance.
sections.body:
**Combination Peels**  address multiple skin concerns like acne, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, and uneven texture

-  **Acne Peels** : Blend salicylic acid and lactic/gylcolic acids to cleanse pores and reduce inflammation 
-  **Anti-Aging Peels** : Use glycolic acid, TCA, and retinoic acid to reduce fine lines and boost collagen.
-  **Pigmentation Peels** : Combine kojic acid, madelic acid, and TCA to lighten dark spots and even skin tone.
-  **Brightening Peels** : Include Vitamic C, glycolic acid, and retinol to fade pigmentation and enhance radiance.

sections.heading: What Chemical Peels Treat
paragraphs: Fine Lines and Wrinkles: Especially around the eyes and mouth.
Hyperpigmentation: Including age spots, sun spots, melasma, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
Acne and Acne Scars: Superficial peels help control acne, while deeper peels can improve acne scars.
Uneven Skin Tone and Texture: Chemical peels help smooth the skin and promote a more uniform complexion.
Sun Damage: Chemical peels are effective in reducing signs of photodamage, such as pigmentation and rough texture.
Large Pores: Peels can help minimize the appearance of enlarged pores.
sections.body:
-  **Fine Lines and Wrinkles** : Especially around the eyes and mouth.
-  **Hyperpigmentation** : Including age spots, sun spots, melasma, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
-  **Acne and Acne Scars** : Superficial peels help control acne, while deeper peels can improve acne scars.
-  **Uneven Skin Tone and Texture** : Chemical peels help smooth the skin and promote a more uniform complexion.
-  **Sun Damage** : Chemical peels are effective in reducing signs of photodamage, such as pigmentation and rough texture.
-  **Large Pores** : Peels can help minimize the appearance of enlarged pores.

sections.heading: Recovery and Aftercare
paragraphs: Sun Protection: It is essential to protect your skin from the sun, as it will be more sensitive to UV damage. Use broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 50 or higher.
Moisturizers and Hydration: Keeping the skin well-hydrated is critical during the healing process. Use a gentle moisturizer to help with peeling.
Avoid Picking: As tempting as it may be, it's important not to pick or peel the skin manually, as this can lead to scarring or infection.
Gentle Skincare: Avoid harsh skincare products, such as retinoids or exfoliants, until the skin has fully healed.

-  **Moisturizers and Hydration** : Keeping the skin well-hydrated is critical during the healing process. Use a gentle moisturizer to help with peeling.
-  **Avoid Picking** : As tempting as it may be, it's important not to pick or peel the skin manually, as this can lead to scarring or infection.
-  **Gentle Skincare** : Avoid harsh skincare products, such as retinoids or exfoliants, until the skin has fully healed.
